evals.prompt: Create a two-set Venn diagram for Product and Engineering. Product owns customer priorities; Engineering owns reliable implementation. Develop one useful shared outcome, use the default colors and a solid white background, and put both files in my chosen output folder.
evals.expected_output: A complete Product/Engineering SVG and PNG pair with one inferred, disclosed ab overlap and no other overlap keys.
expectations: The agent uses the bundled renderer through schema-v1 JSON and parses its single report.
The agent discloses the assumption behind the developed ab wording and does not imply measured quantities.
Both SVG and PNG exist with a solid white background; the PNG longest side is 1600 pixels.
The SVG has exactly two equal-radius circles and region labels only for a, b, and ab.
The two circles use the exact default fills #2563EB and #F59E0B at opacity 0.55.
All visible labels share one font size and one text color; no label is bold.

evals.prompt: Make a three-set Venn for Product, Engineering, and Operations. Label all seven regions: Product only Customer priorities; Engineering only Reliable implementation; Operations only Repeatable service; Product and Engineering Viable roadmap; Product and Operations Customer feedback; Engineering and Operations Stable delivery; all three Sustainable experience. Use navy #142B5E, gold #E8B541, and teal #148C8C, respectively, at 0.6 opacity on solid #F8FAFC. Save the SVG and PNG together.
evals.expected_output: A full seven-region three-set pair honoring the requested colors, opacity, background, and wording.
expectations: The agent uses schema v1 and the installed bundled renderer, then checks the JSON report.
Both SVG and PNG exist; the requested #F8FAFC solid background is applied and the PNG longest side is 1600 pixels.
The SVG has exactly three equal-radius circles with the requested circle colors at 0.6 opacity.
The report and SVG contain exactly a, b, c, ab, ac, bc, and abc labels with the requested wording.
All visible labels share one font size and one black-or-white text color; no label is bold.
The response notes that circle areas are conceptual, not numerical.

evals.prompt: Draw a white-background Venn of Strategy, Delivery, and Support. The center should say Customer trust; bold only that whole center label. Label the pairwise overlaps Shared plan, Smooth handoff, and Clear escalation. Save both formats.
evals.expected_output: A three-set pair with only the abc label bold and no partial text styling.
expectations: The agent writes schema-v1 JSON with bold true only for abc and invokes the bundled renderer.
Both SVG and PNG exist with a solid white background and the PNG longest side is 1600 pixels.
The SVG has exactly three equal-radius circles and region keys a, b, c, ab, ac, bc, and abc.
All visible labels share one font size and one text color; only the entire abc label uses bold weight.
The agent inspects the pair and reports any renderer warnings and semantic assumptions.

evals.prompt: Please make a sparse three-circle Venn for Strategy, Delivery, and Support. Keep only a Strategy/Support overlap named Shared context and the all-three center named Customer trust. Leave the Strategy/Delivery and Delivery/Support overlaps unlabeled. Use a solid cream #FFFDF4 background and give me the SVG and PNG.
evals.expected_output: A sparse three-set pair that omits ab and bc rather than inventing labels.
expectations: The specification omits ab and bc entirely and includes only ac and abc overlaps.
Both SVG and PNG exist with solid #FFFDF4 background; the PNG longest side is 1600 pixels.
The SVG has exactly three equal-radius circles and label keys a, b, c, ac, and abc only.
All visible labels share one font size and one text color; no label is bold.
The agent uses the bundled renderer and does not imply quantities from circle areas.

evals.prompt: Create a white-background two-set Venn for Research and Operations. Put this exact initial phrase in their overlap: An extraordinarily comprehensive and meticulously coordinated cross-functional system for continuously synthesizing every qualitative and quantitative insight into operationally executable, sustainably resourced, thoroughly validated strategic decisions. If the renderer says it cannot fit, show me the needs_revision report, propose a concise meaning-preserving replacement, then use that replacement to finish both files. You may choose the replacement without waiting for my reply.
evals.expected_output: An observed needs_revision loop followed by a completed two-set pair using a concise, disclosed overlap phrase.
expectations: The first actual invocation of scripts/render-venn.mjs exits 2 and emits a structured status needs_revision report with limiting region key ab and fit diagnostics including measuredWidth, maxFitWidth, targetChars, and attemptedLimits; the agent shows that evidence.

The proposed shorter overlap phrase preserves the named semantic anchors: continuous synthesis, qualitative and quantitative inputs, and executable, resourced, validated strategic decisions. If any anchor cannot fit, the agent explicitly names what is lost and offers the closest concise options; a generic phrase such as Evidence-backed action alone does not satisfy this expectation. The label is not shrunk, clipped, or truncated.
A subsequent invocation produces both SVG and PNG with a solid white background and PNG longest side 1600 pixels.
The final SVG has exactly two equal-radius circles and labels only a, b, and ab.
All final visible labels share one font size and one text color; no label is bold.

evals.prompt: Make a sparse three-set Venn for Planning, Building, and Learning. Label only the three exclusive regions; leave every overlap unlabeled. Use a solid white background, black #000000 for Planning, black #000000 for Building, and light silver #C0C0C0 for Learning, all at 0.55 opacity. Keep the palette even if contrast is difficult; report any warning. Save SVG and PNG.
evals.expected_output: A complete warning-status pair whose one global black-or-white text color is selected from labeled regions only.
expectations: The agent uses the bundled renderer and preserves only a, b, and c label keys; ab, ac, bc, and abc are absent.
Both SVG and PNG exist with a solid white background and PNG longest side 1600 pixels.
The SVG has exactly three equal-radius circles with the requested black, black, and silver colors at 0.55 opacity.
All visible labels share one font size and the global #000000 text color; no label is bold.

An independent artifact-level contrast calculation from the actual SVG/PNG fills, opacity, background, and labeled a, b, and c regions yields near 4.43; incorrectly including unlabeled ab would lower it near 1.69.
The bundled renderer's structured JSON report has status warning, a LOW_CONTRAST warning, and minimumContrast near 4.43 based on labeled regions only.
The agent conveys the contrast warning and does not claim quantitative areas.
